p02-written-exemplars.html.q: This shows the college wants to control the girls.
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: Labelled as analysis but it only restates the rule. Say how the instruction controls the girls: what they are expected to do, and what would happen if they did not.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: However, when they get to the Rock the rules do not work anymore
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: The instinct to turn to a counter-point is right, but 'however' is a signpost with no argument behind it. Explain why the rules fail, not just that they do.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: The music is calm at first, then there is a scary noise.
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: Describes what happens without naming the technique or what it does to the audience. Name the soundtrack element and the effect.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: Therefore I agree with the statement.
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: The conclusion repeats the contention with no new idea. The question asks 'to what extent', and no degree of agreement is given.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: The college lives by the clock, and the picnic is planned around it
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: A clear topic sentence that makes a claim about the topic, not just a description of the setting.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: The mechanical measures of the college become meaningless
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: Precise word choice that turns the stopped watches into a claim about the college's whole way of life.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: The girls are not conquered so much as taken
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: A qualified conclusion: it accepts the statement while pointing out what the film does instead. This is what 'to what extent' rewards.
A precise reading of the opening: the film reverses the expected order of authority between society and nature.

p02-written-exemplars.html.q: It is revealed as a fiction the moment it meets the bush
p02-written-exemplars.html.n: The contention goes beyond 'the college fails'. It argues the order was never real, which makes the answer more than a yes.
A closing point that ties the argument to the film's refusal to explain the disappearance.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: The villagers all come to the square on time.
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Scene-setting with no link to the question. Say what the punctuality shows about conformity.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: This shows the villagers are friendly
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: A vague judgement. Friendliness does not support the claim about fear, so this point needs a different reason.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: This shows people are afraid of being different, so they make her quiet.
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Good instinct, but the claim is asserted rather than shown. Use the words of the speakers as evidence.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: So I agree with the statement.
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: The conclusion restates the position with no reason. Explain how the story supports the claim.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: The villagers do not discuss the lottery; they simply attend it.
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: A precise topic sentence that makes a claim about behaviour rather than describing events.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: conformity is presented as fairness, and dissent is treated as poor manners
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Strong analysis of how the story uses the language of fairness to enforce conformity.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: The fear of being left out is greater than any sympathy for Tessie
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: A clear claim about the crowd's priorities, supported by the sequence of events.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: the pleasantness is the first thing the story asks us to distrust
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: A sharp opening that treats the setting as part of the argument, not as description.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: Conformity starts before anybody is asked to conform
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Strong structural point: it tells the assessor where the argument begins.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: turns fairness into a matter of who is willing to play along
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Precise word choice that turns a phrase into an argument about power.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: The claim is a warning rather than an argument
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Says what kind of claim it is, and what that does to the question. Naming the move is what lifts the paragraph.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: Reason has no hearing once the crowd has decided
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: A clear thematic topic sentence about reason and the group, not about a single character.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: This shows tradition is stronger than the people
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Asserted rather than shown: say how the ending makes tradition stronger, using the crowd's actions.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: The black box shows how far the village has let tradition outlast its meaning
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: The object is used as evidence for the idea, which is the step the medium band needs.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: tradition gains its power by seeming practical
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: Precise language for how the proverb works: it sounds sensible even though its reason is never tested.

p03-written-exemplars.html.q: So tradition wins not by being right but by being shared
p03-written-exemplars.html.n: A confident conclusion to the argument. It answers the question by saying what kind of power tradition has.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: she talks about how the trains in Westmere are always late
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The contention is paraphrased as a topic, not stated as an argument — we learn what the letter is about, not what it wants or who it is trying to move.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: uses alot of persuasive techniques to get the reader to agree with her
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: ‘The reader’ is never defined. The criteria ask for the intended audience — Westmere commuters, residents and the local member — and this essay never names them.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: This is an anecdote and it makes the reader feel sorry for her
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Technique named, effect stated, but nothing in between. Push further: what in the anecdote creates sympathy, and why does that sympathy help her argument?

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: which is funny
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The humour is noticed but stops at the reaction. The joke has a job — it makes Raman seem reasonable before she gets angry — and that job is where the marks are.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: because nurses are important and the hospital was already short of staff
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A good instinct: the shift to patient care is spotted. It needs linking to Raman’s credibility and to the reader’s sense that the problem reaches beyond commuters.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Statistics are used to make an argument more believable
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A generic definition that could be pasted into any essay. Assessors reward analysis of these particular figures — the fall from nine in ten to fewer than seven.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: The graph is grey and the last bar is darker then the others
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The visual is described but not interpreted. Why is the last bar darker? Answering that one question would turn description into analysis.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: This is another anecdote and it is sad
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The second anecdote is treated exactly like the first. The essay misses that Ella speaks to a different part of the audience — parents and young people.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: a rhetorical question when she says
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Misidentified: this is not a question at all. Raman is anticipating an opposing view so she can rebut it — a technique worth far more when named accurately.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: so the reader will agree that driving is not a good idea
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The cost figure is picked up, but its purpose — turning the opponents’ solution into evidence for her own case — goes unseen.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: the reader will think the government doesnt care about people in the country
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The closest this essay comes to the letter’s central idea of fairness. Developed, it could have anchored a whole paragraph.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Repetition makes the argument stick in the readers head
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A stock effect that fits any repetition anywhere. Better: ‘I am asking’ sounds like a formal list of demands, and each demand is modest, so refusing them looks unreasonable.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: This is humour and it makes the reader laugh
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The final line is read as a joke only. Its sting — a last reminder of unreliability, aimed at the local member — is the point.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: She is very persuasive because she is a nurse and she uses lots of different techniques
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The conclusion judges the letter instead of analysing it, and counts techniques instead of explaining how the argument builds. Section C never asks whether a piece is persuasive.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: contends that the state government has neglected the Westmere train line
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Contention, form, writer, audience and tone all in the opening paragraph — the checklist done properly.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: many of whom would also rely on the train, as well as the local member of parliament
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The audience is split into groups. The essay could go further by showing later which parts of the letter target which group.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: she immediately places the reader on the train with her
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A precise effect: the anecdote is read as a way of putting the reader in the writer’s position, not just as a sad story.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: As such, the audience, particularly other commuters, are more inclined to see Raman as one of them
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Effect chained to a specific part of the audience — the how of persuasion, not just the that.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: This shifts the tone from humorous to serious
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Tracks a tonal shift at the moment it happens — the beginnings of sequencing analysis.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: The use of the inclusive pronoun
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Technique named accurately and taken straight to its effect on community feeling.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: The final bar is shaded darker than the rest
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Unlike Essay I, the darker bar is explained: it draws the eye to the lowest figure. Visual feature, purpose and effect in one move.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: is getting worse and is not just having a bad week
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Understands what the graph adds — a trend rather than an incident — which is exactly why a writer would include it.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: anticipates the argument that people should
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Correctly identifies the rebuttal. Push further: show how the rebuttal turns the opposing view into support for her own.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: by describing driving home after a night shift
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A vivid image linked to an appeal to safety, but the analysis is brief. A sentence on why this image is hard to forget would lift it.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: causing the audience to lose trust in their promises
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Effect stated on the government’s image — the essay keeps track of who the argument is aimed at.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Although she says
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The concession is noticed, but the edge in it is not quite named. ‘Good on them’ carries sarcasm, and that is worth spelling out.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: which broadens her argument from a personal complaint to a community issue
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A strong structural observation: the widening scope of the argument is read as strategy.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: which makes her demands seem reasonable and clear
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Better than a stock comment on repetition — the effect is tied to how the demands are received.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: As a result, the audience are more likely to accept
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The ‘the audience are more likely to’ formula keeps effects present throughout, but by the third or fourth use it shows. Varying it reads as more confident.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Overall, Priya Raman uses personal anecdotes, statistics, a bar graph and a comparison
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The conclusion lists techniques rather than synthesising how the argument develops — a typical middle-range finish.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Raman writes less to inform them than to give their shared frustration a shape and a target
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A sophisticated reading of purpose: these readers already know the facts, so the letter’s job is to channel their frustration. This frames the whole essay.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Her tone moves from wry, almost weary humour into measured indignation
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The tonal journey is mapped in the introduction, so every paragraph after it has a place to sit — strategic sequencing from the start.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Raman opens not with an argument but with a scene
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Reads the opening as a choice with a purpose, explaining why the letter begins this way before analysing what it says.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Humour allows Raman to establish herself as reasonable rather than shrill
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The humour is analysed for what it does to her credibility, not just for its effect on mood.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Her credibility as a nurse is doing quiet work here
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Ethos identified without being reduced to a label: the essay shows how her profession persuades without her having to argue it.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: land with the flatness of someone stating a fact that should be shocking but no longer is
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Analyses sentence length and rhythm and connects them to the reader’s response — language at the level of syntax.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: Having made the problem personal, Raman then makes it measurable
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: A clean linking sentence that names the argument’s next move. The essay always knows where it is in the text.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: are easier for a general reader to feel than a percentage
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Explains why the writer chose fractions over percentages — close attention to small choices and the audience they suit.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: The grey, unadorned design gives the graph the look of neutral data rather than campaign material
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The visual’s style, not just its content, is analysed and linked to authority. High-range visual analysis.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: quietly recruits every reader who has stood on that platform into her argument
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Inclusive language tied to a specific group of readers, with a strong, precise verb.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: speaks to parents and to anyone worried about whether young people have a future in the town
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Differentiated audience: one anecdote is shown to target a different group from another.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: The decline of the train is gradually connected to the decline of the town itself
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Identifies how the stakes rise over the course of the letter — conceptual, not technique-by-technique.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: she has turned her opponents
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The rebuttal is analysed as a reversal: the objection becomes evidence for her case. This is the step Essay II missed.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: The balanced structure of this phrase exposes the gap between words and action
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Sentence structure read as argument — the parallel phrasing itself makes the case.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: a concession that sounds generous but carries an edge of sarcasm
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The double function of the concession is drawn out, showing close attention to tone.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: marks a turning point
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Locates a hinge in the letter and explains what changes after it.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: which makes refusing them seem unreasonable
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Explains the logic behind modest demands — persuasion analysed as reasoning as well as emotion.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: quietly suggesting that those who make decisions about the train do not have to live with it
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Reads the subtext of a single aside and identifies its target: the local member.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: now the joke has a sting
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: Connects the ending back to the opening, reading the letter’s structure as a whole.

p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.q: transforms a familiar local grievance into an argument about fairness and respect
p06-sample-analysing-argument-essays.htm.n: The conclusion synthesises what the letter does and why, rather than listing how.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: one of my aunts asked me a seemingly-innocuous question
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Opens in scene, mid-tension — the reflective frame is established through story, not announcement.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: eyebrows drawn together and raised like little anthills
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: A comic image that returns later — recurring motifs give a reflective piece the cohesion the criteria ask for.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: However, conventional wisdom is usually right
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: The reflection genuinely turns against itself — complexity of thought, not a straight line to a moral.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: I twirled some spaghetti around my fork
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Ends back inside the opening scene with the title spoken in dialogue — frame closed, title integrated, purpose achieved.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: I took a certain tormented delight
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Self-aware, wry self-description — the reflective voice earns trust by being honest about its own oddness.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: You only buy books for a new highschool year six times
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: The piece steps into the parents' perspective and counts what they lose — empathy that complicates the narrator's own case.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: it was heavy and liberating all at once
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: A compact paradox at the emotional climax — feeling rendered precisely, without melodrama.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: The extracurricular lady peered at me over her bifocals
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: A minor character sketched in one line — economy of characterisation that keeps a short piece moving.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: running up and down the same five notes with deliberate focus
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Concrete practice detail — the writing shows obsession rather than declaring it.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: What was maths, with all its useless formulae repeated over and over
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: A rhetorical question in the narrator's teenage register — the voice stays consistent with the remembered self.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: then internships, then grad roles, then middle-management jobs
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Cumulative listing enacts the trap it describes — form mirroring meaning.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: with my dress almost at my ankles
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: One costume detail places the narrator's age and awkwardness without a word of explanation.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: as much as she loved us
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: The mother's sacrifice is honoured even while its pressure is described — generosity toward the antagonist deepens the reflection.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: It was almost true
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: A three-word sentence that admits the temptation to lie — honesty about dishonesty, the reflective mode at its best.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: extremely little experience to guide the decision
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: The argument widens from one family to a critique of how everyone chooses a life — the personal essay earns its general claim.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: most would tell you that I have high confidence. Unfortunately, the opposite is true
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: The confession establishes the piece's honesty contract with the reader in sentence two.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: The only band that had any space was the orchestra, and they needed a piccolo player
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Chance narrows to one instrument — the piece engineers its own inevitability.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: As painful as my practice was for all within earshot
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Self-deprecation keeps the obsession likeable — the narrator hears themselves as others do.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: Should I lie, tell her that I’ll be doing medicine too?
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: The climax staged as live inner debate — options weighed in real time before the answer.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.q: then stony, awkward dinners
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-19-20.ht.n: Conflict rendered through mealtimes — the family's language of silence.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: a cruel god beating down upon me from its court of cloudless blue
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The first image establishes voice and displacement at once — sensory writing doing thematic work.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: like the caterpillar confined within the fecund dark of a chrysalis
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The stimulus is woven into the piece's own imagery rather than quoted at — the meaningful connection the criteria require.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: hang a garland of fresh marigolds underneath it every morning
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: Resolution through inherited ritual — the journey lands somewhere earned, and the title is answered by action rather than statement.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: Slowly, one choice at a time, aligning more and more
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: Anaphora enacts the meaning — the repeated structure performs the gradual assimilation it describes.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: He jokingly called it a gift from our motherland
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: Character revealed through one line of reported speech — humour carrying grief, voice doing double work.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: I hear his voice in their adversities. It feels like home
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The final line resolves the piece's two longings — father and home — in one closing image.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: wrapped up in their idiosyncratic lifestyles since twilight
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The remembered homeland is populated, not idealised — nostalgia given texture and inhabitants.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: saw Laxmi, the Hindu goddess of prosperity, hidden in every crack
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: A cultural frame carried into the new landscape — the father's optimism rendered through belief rather than adjectives.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: flitting from English to Hindi to Bengali
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The tape recorder plants the piece's resolution — storytelling as inheritance — long before the ending states it.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: aiding those fragmented because of migration
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The personal journey widens into vocation — the framework idea resolved as a life, not a lesson.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: It would wake up with the soft, repetitive chants
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The house is personified as waking and sleeping — the family home made a living character in two sentences.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: He paid no heed, jovially punctuating his latest tales
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The father's resilience is shown through how he tells stories, not stated — character through manner.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: consuming the liminal space between waking and sleeping
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The racism's psychological cost is located precisely — in the space before sleep — rather than described generally.
After paragraphs of rich imagery, grief arrives in five plain words — the register drop is the emotional peak.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: There was just me, my father, and the red earth
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The new country reduced to three nouns — emptiness enacted by syntax.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: a self-titled opportunist, yearning to abandon the stagnancy
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The father characterised through his own self-description — affectionate irony.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: He would rasp his smooth tenor into a small tape recorder
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The dying voice given texture — 'rasp' against 'smooth tenor' measures the decline.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: I honour his memory by telling his extraordinary story
p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.n: The father's dying instruction answered verb for verb — the piece keeps its promise.

p05-sample-creating-texts-piece-finding-.q: granting me the insurmountable pleasure of listening to a thousand stories
